title: sansevieria elliptica
intro: Sansevieria elliptica, commonly known as the "Bowstring Hemp," is a species of succulent plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is known for its air-purifying properties and has been used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include reducing stress, promoting better sleep, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
